high_level_description: The image shows a person standing indoors with a cityscape visible through the window behind them. The individual is wearing a dark-colored, short-sleeved shirt with the collar slightly open, revealing a bit of chest hair. They have sunglasses hanging from the collar of their shirt. The person has short, dark hair and is wearing small earrings in both ears. The background features an interior space with a light-colored wall and a glass partition on the right side. Through the window, there is a view of a city at night, with illuminated buildings and some greenery visible.
